patch.value: beads validate does not detect dependency cycles

validateBeadsText checked dangling refs, dup ids, unknown status, missing title — but never walked the edge graph, so a circular blocked-by chain (A→B→A) passed validation cleanly. Such a cycle is a deadlock the real bd tooling rejects and produces an unschedulable graph once imported into pm.

validate detects directed cycles in the in-file blocked-by graph (incl. self-deps) and reports them as dependency_cycle errors; only in-file ids considered (no false positives on cross-workspace/dangling edges); acyclic files unaffected; helper unit-tested + e2e verified
validate now flags circular blocked-by chains (incl. self-deps) as dependency_cycle errors over the in-file graph; cross-workspace/dangling edges excluded so no false positives
cyclic beads file fails validation with a clear cycle message; acyclic files pass
verified e2e: 'circular dependency: a → b → a' error + non-zero exit on cyclic file; acyclic passes; 34 tests green
